title: Cute Magical Fairy Clipart PNG
author: clemencian
description:
🧚‍♀️ ✨ Cute Magical Fairy & Princess Watercolor Clipart PNG Bundle 🌸
Bring an enchanted fairytale to life with this sweet and whimsical watercolor fairy collection! This magical set features three beautiful little fairies with elegant blonde hair buns, wearing lovely pink dresses and delicate purple wings.
This charming bundle includes 9 carefully detailed elements to help you build your own enchanted forest scenes. Alongside the three expressive fairy poses (flying gracefully, sitting on a beautiful purple flower, and standing while waving hello), you will find 6 magical accessories: a golden star wand, a royal gold crown with a pink heart jewel, pink ballet slippers, a purple butterfly, a matching floral arrangement, and a golden star pendant. Everything is beautifully highlighted with sparkling gold glitter accents for a truly magical, premium finish.
Perfectly illustrated in dreamy pastel pinks and purples, this set is an absolute must-have for creating enchanted garden birthday invitations, magical nursery wall art, sweet little girl apparel, fairy-themed party decor, and whimsical scrapbooking projects!
✨ WHAT’S INCLUDED
✔ 9 High-Quality PNG Elements
✔ Transparent Background
✔ High Resolution: 300 DPI
✔ Size: Approx. 3000 x 3000 px (10×10 inches)
✔ 1 Fairy Flying Gracefully with Eyes Closed
✔ 1 Fairy Sitting on a Purple Flower holding a Wand
✔ 1 Fairy Standing and Waving Hello
✔ 1 Magical Gold Star Wand
✔ 1 Royal Gold Crown with Heart Jewel
✔ 1 Pair of Pink Ballet Slippers
✔ 1 Purple Fairy Butterfly
✔ 1 Purple Floral Bouquet Arrangement
✔ 1 Golden Star Pendant/Charm
✔ Print Ready & Instant Digital Download
(Please note: This is a DIGITAL download. No physical product will be shipped).
🌸 PERFECT FOR
Fairy Theme Birthday Invitations
Enchanted Garden Party Decor

Magical Princess Sublimation Designs
